description: Three completed author-created historical research reports prepared from public information. This is an output showcase, not live recommendations or a validated accuracy backtest.

gallery.method: Uncropped PDF page 1 from each published report, rasterized with PyMuPDF and composed with Pillow. No AI-generated illustration.

privacy.scope: PDF standard metadata, XMP, complete text layer, link annotations, PDF object dictionaries, attachment count; known machine username and common path/IP/email/token/prompt patterns.
privacy.result: No detected local machine paths, private-network addresses, email addresses, known local username, credential patterns or internal prompts in published copies. Zero embedded file attachments.
privacy.limitations: Automated inspection is pattern-based and text-layer based, not proof that every possible personal datum is absent. Rendering geometry and nonblank images were checked; no full visual-layout review is claimed.
privacy.original_locations: Not published. Source-original SHA-256 values are provided without local filesystem paths.
privacy.excluded_material: No original corporate PDFs, raw market feeds, datasets, research model files, agent reviews, logs, or internal research workspaces are included.

responsible_usage.purpose: Learn source attribution, accounting scope, cash conversion, explicit assumptions, risk and conditional validation from completed examples.
responsible_usage.data_status: Historical numbers and cited facts are retained from the original report snapshot; they were not independently reverified against live sources for this showcase publication.
responsible_usage.no_performance_claim: No forecast accuracy, win rate, investment return, or backtest-performance claim.
responsible_usage.quote_timing: The report date does not mean every market, FX and financial observation is as of the same instant. Read each report and market_snapshot entry.

rights.authored_material: Original report prose and author-created charts are offered under the repository MIT license to the extent the contributors hold the rights.
rights.third_party_material: Underlying market data, quoted company disclosures, company names/logos, trademarks, and embedded font software remain subject to their respective owners and licenses; MIT does not grant rights in them.
rights.sources: Public-source links and report citation IDs are retained; source documents and raw data feeds are not redistributed.
